description: ACT Heavy Vehicle Conditions and Network is a map resource listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by ACT Government City Services. The ACT Restricted Access Vehicle Network contains maps and lists of authorised roads and approved routes for each heavy vehicle type is in accordance with the ACT's Performance Based Standards. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-08-01. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
